scope.property: The actual owner-derived requirement population must be available to every downstream consumer in full, or the persisted decision must explicitly identify an incomplete, budget-limited result. A count limit cannot silently become a complete denominator or change source authority.

scope.not_an_external_fact: 40 is a current schema max_length, not a limit established by an external fact, authority decision, or original criterion.

options.summary: Use persisted obligation graph, claim ledger, participation evaluations, and method-preflight refs as the complete input basis. Reconstruct the full ConstraintStoreEntry population at the consumer or resolve snapshot_ref to the complete source artifact; never treat a missing inline list as empty.
options.current_fit: Upstream artifacts and the raw snapshot-basis candidate are persisted before the typed model rejects it, but the failed packet drops those refs, the PDC DTO has no page-ref contract, and current readers iterate constraint_records. Existing refs are not a working substitute without a real bridge/reader change.
options.migration_impact: Keep prior inline v1 snapshots readable. Add a versioned resolver/recompute path and route every real consumer through it; reconcile reconstructed entry identities/statuses with exact source artifacts.
options.status_impact: Complete only if the consumer recomputes the whole population and reconciles a frozen count/digest. Missing, corrupt, or mismatched inputs remain blocking; no zero default.
options.authority_impact: Refs establish lineage, not institutional authority. Preserve source-authority-verification-missing separately.
options.time_impact: Use refs from one producer request/run and exact generated_at/rule version; do not combine current graph refs with historical entries.
options.falsifier: Run the actual 108-record producer and fresh consumer, reconcile all entry IDs/statuses/routes, then remove or corrupt one referenced artifact while leaving its marker and require refusal. Keep source authority missing independently visible.

options.summary: Increase max_length or remove it so all entries remain embedded in constraint_records.
options.current_fit: The observed case needs at least 108; it does not establish 108 as a general upper bound or justify an unbounded list.
options.migration_impact: Changes PDC validation/JSON schema. Old readers capped at 40 reject new snapshots, so preserve v1 reads and define a compatible versioned contract. Measure resource bounds before choosing a maximum.
options.status_impact: Under-limit snapshots may still be incomplete if a producer truncates. Validate complete IDs/counts from the owner graph, not only list length; over-limit remains fail-closed.
options.authority_impact: More rows confer no authority. Keep source authority and candidate status separately composed.
options.time_impact: Preserve generated_at/rule-version binding; do not reinterpret historical v1 records under the widened validator.
options.falsifier: Run actual populations at 40, 41, and 108; verify full IDs/statuses in fresh reads and failure on one removed item. Any proposed maximum needs an owner-derived bound+1 case and measured resource rationale.

options.summary: Keep a bounded page size (candidate 40) and persist a versioned manifest referencing all immutable pages and source artifacts. Investigate existing snapshot_ref as the handle; if its contract cannot carry that meaning, G must authorize a typed companion/versioned DTO first.
options.current_fit: Supports a larger full population while keeping per-object payloads bounded. Requires real PDC and Runtime consumer changes; persisting page markers alone does not complete the capability.
options.migration_impact: Add versioned page/manifest representation and readers. Keep v1 inline artifacts historical. Bind schema/rule version, run/snapshot identity, page ordinal/count/digest, total record count, source/profile refs, and generated_at. Each page stays <=40.
options.status_impact: Only a fully resolved, content-bound, duplicate-free page set reconciling to the total is complete. Missing/corrupt/mixed-run pages block. Preserve entry status/refinement route.
options.authority_impact: Pages preserve evidence/status but do not establish source authority. An unverified source remains separately blocking after complete readback.
options.time_impact: All pages share the same frozen time, source closure, profile, and rule version; never mix runs or backfill old artifacts silently.
options.falsifier: Use actual complete populations of 40, 41, and 108. Fresh-read and reconcile all entry IDs/statuses/routes. Missing, duplicate, reordered, corrupted, or foreign-run pages must refuse while preserving the separate source-authority reason.

options.summary: Keep the 40 total cap and refuse completeness above it with an explicit budget-limited result; never truncate to 40 or claim a complete/empty population.
options.current_fit: Smallest interim behavior, but the current catch does not communicate it: it returns generic basis-unverified and drops source refs. Status name/composition are not adjudicated; no new PDC/Core field or status is authorized by this packet.
options.migration_impact: No snapshot schema increase, but failure packet/API/readers need a versioned persisted reason, actual count, and source refs. Existing generic-reason consumers must continue to block; old <=40 artifacts retain meaning.
options.status_impact: Keep blocking and authority-downgrading while incomplete. Budget limitation and source-authority verification are distinct and may coexist; never convert to success/warn-only/empty.
options.authority_impact: Readable source bytes are not authority. Preserve the source-authority reason independently of the capacity reason.
options.time_impact: Bind measured count and cap reason to exact input refs, generated_at, and producer rule version; recompute on readback.
options.falsifier: At 40, full snapshot/readback succeeds only if source authority is separately admitted. At 41/108, persist a specific blocking budget refusal; fresh replay keeps both capacity and source-authority reasons and does not drop refs or return empty.

recommendation_for_g_decision.selected_narrow_variant: paged_complete_snapshot, keeping 40 only as a candidate per-page bound and routing complete pages through every actual consumer
recommendation_for_g_decision.why: 108 is a measured actual population, not a justified general cap. Pages preserve the full owner population and bound each payload. Reuse current CAS refs for lineage; current readers do not consume them as a full population today.
recommendation_for_g_decision.interim_safety: Until G selects representation and status/schema semantics, retain fail-closed behavior and make no full-population or positive-authority claim. Current generic refusal is safe against promotion but loses a distinct capacity reason, source-authority reason, and compiled refs; this is an implementation gap, not an accepted budget posture.
recommendation_for_g_decision.g_decision_required: Decide whether snapshot_ref can carry a complete paged manifest under its current contract or a versioned PDC/Runtime DTO is required; decide whether 40 remains a page size; define status composition and compatibility readers. This recommendation is not G acceptance.
